claims.statement: 膜厚速率模型写作 t_p = K cos^n(alpha) cos^m(beta) / r_p^2；n、m分别表示源发射和凝结角响应，r_p为源到工件点距离。
claims.locator: 全文 §2 Theory and Experiment, Eq. (1)

claims.locator: 全文 §3 Results, Fig. 2及其前后段落

claims.statement: shadow matrix用分区系数将遮挡份额与掩模形状参数建立线性关系，并由矩阵求解形状参数；针对不同材料响应联合设计互补掩模。

claims.statement: Eq. (1) gives the incremental point contribution from source-to-substrate coordinates and plume exponent n; Eq. (2) weights each motion step by normalized time-dependent rate R_N(t) and sums through planetary motion. Each step uses 60/(wU) seconds for planetary carrier revolution rate w rpm and U subdivisions per revolution.
claims.locator: Accepted manuscript PDF pp.1–2, Eqs. (1)–(2); text immediately after Eq. (2)
limitations: Accepted manuscript first-page DOI/date fields are placeholders; journal citation and DOI verified separately at Optica/PubMed.

Full-trajectory-cycle assumption, sample chamber/gear ratios and modeled oscillations isolate one effect; they do not describe every finite real layer or support applying the reported maximum ~3% error to user hardware.

claims.statement: Modeled rate fluctuation effects depend on the fluctuation period relative to planetary motion; the paper reports fast oscillations as less impactful and slow/harmonic oscillations as potentially problematic.
claims.locator: Abstract and manuscript Figs. 1–3 with results/discussion, pp.2–4
limitations: Conclusions are model-specific. Author notes system-specific resonances and recommends evaluating actual rate harmonics rather than assuming universal error levels.
Do not rewrite or duplicate the T01 source archive; cite this as T02:M05 and T01:S12.
This is a source-model paper, not an independent experimental validation of every geometry or model component.
